delivery.outcome: Publish wellmanifest.worktrees/v4 with repository-local relative linked worktrees, repository-local leases, deterministic planning and read-only legacy inventory.
nonGoals: Do not move or delete any existing worktree or duplicate clone
Do not run broad git clean over a repository containing nested worktrees
Do not implement Git or filesystem allocation effects in this domain pack
Do not relocate this final v3-created ticket worktree

architecture.decision: Make the primary checkout the allocation anchor, require Git relative worktree links, and expose observation-only classification for registered legacy and anomalous paths.
interfaceChanges: Planner input changes from workspace root to primary checkout
dataChanges: Every new layout record declares linkMode=relative and minimumGitVersion=2.51.0
architecture.rollback: Revert before runtime adoption; inventory never mutates legacy paths, and existing worktrees remain preserved for an explicitly authorized migration.

validation.evidence: POSIX and Windows plans conform exactly to the repository-local v4 layout.
Read-only inventory classifies v1, v2, v3, v4, /tmp, duplicate and unknown registered worktrees.
A scratch repository demonstrates relocation failure for absolute links and recovery through git worktree repair --relative-paths.
The local Git meets 2.51.0 and exposes relative-path add and repair flags.
The exact governed release diff passes without changing files outside the approved scope.
